_schema.description: CNCF Platform Engineering Maturity Model self-assessment. This file is hand-maintained (not generated by stats-go) — update it directly when re-assessing maturity.
_schema.generated_at: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last time this file was edited.
_schema.model_url: Link to the CNCF Platform Engineering Maturity Model whitepaper used as the assessment rubric.
_schema.dimensions[].id: Stable machine-readable slug for the dimension (used as chart label key).
_schema.dimensions[].name: Human-readable dimension name from the CNCF model.
_schema.dimensions[].evidence: Short free-text note on why this level was chosen — link to workflows, docs, or dashboards as evidence.
_schema.dimensions[].last_assessed: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) this dimension was last (re-)assessed.

dimensions.name: Provisioning
dimensions.evidence: Image builds (Bluefin/Aurora/Bazzite/uCore/etc.) are fully declarative via Containerfiles and reproducible bootc image builds, but environment/infra provisioning outside of image builds is still mostly manual.

dimensions.name: Configuration
dimensions.evidence: Configuration is version-controlled (Containerfiles, systemd units, just recipes) with renovate managing dependency drift, but there is no central config management plane across the ecosystem's many repos.

dimensions.name: Observability
dimensions.evidence: This dashboard (bootc-ecosystem) provides cross-repo build health, testhub package status, contributor/PR metrics, and daily-refreshed KPIs, but lacks distributed tracing / SLO alerting since these are mostly static sites rather than live services.

dimensions.name: Onboarding
dimensions.evidence: CONTRIBUTING docs exist in most repos and AGENTS.md/skills files capture operational knowledge for agents, but there is no self-service golden-path template for spinning up a new image variant.

dimensions.name: Workflows
dimensions.evidence: GitHub Actions drive builds, tests, and deploys for every tracked repo with daily scheduled runs and continue-on-error isolation between data sources, but workflow reuse/templating across repos is inconsistent.

dimensions.name: Security
dimensions.evidence: OpenSSF Scorecard and supply-chain (cosign/SBOM/Sigstore) signals are tracked per-repo (src/data/scorecard.json, supply-chain.json), but there is no unified policy gate blocking merges on regressions.

dimensions.name: Cost
dimensions.evidence: No cost tracking or FinOps tooling exists yet for CI minutes, registry storage, or CDN egress across the ecosystem.
